name: sample-room-os
description: Sample Room OS is a single-factory sample-room operations system.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @sample-room/shared && npm run dev -w @sample-room/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @sample-room/shared && npm run dev -w @sample-room/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sample-room/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sample-room/api && npm run typecheck -w @sample-room/web && npm run typecheck -w @sample-room/wechat-miniprogram
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sample-room/shared && npm run build -w @sample-room/api && npm run build -w @sample-room/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sample-room/shared && npm run test -w @sample-room/api && npm run test -w @sample-room/web && npm run test -w @sample-room/wechat-miniprogram && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/tests/Test-ManualAcceptanceStartup.ps1
scripts.pre-pr: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
